clips.speaker: How Home
clips.title: 龙泰资管郝洪：科技硬件与AI领涨，传统行业承压，市场内部分化加剧
title_lines: 传统行业承压，市场内部分化加剧

subtitles.en: Yeah, well I think if you look at the general overall Chinese market index, it hasn't done much this year, it's lagging behind the US peers.
subtitles.zh: 是的，我认为如果你看整体中国市场指数，今年表现平平，落后于美国同行。

subtitles.en: But then if you look at the China export and also the star 50 for example, many of the Chinese tech hardware stocks are actually listed on this exchange and they're doing exceedingly well.
subtitles.zh: 但如果你看中国出口和科创50指数，许多中国科技硬件公司都在这个交易所上市，表现非常出色。

subtitles.en: And also if you look at the Chinese exports, if you look at the tech hardware, semiconductor related sectors, export growth is up year-on-year, 40-50 percent, and export price is surging as well.
subtitles.zh: 此外，中国出口中科技硬件、半导体相关领域，出口同比增长40-50%，出口价格也在飙升。
en_highlights: export growth is up year-on-year, 40-50 percent

subtitles.en: So that is telling you that there's a huge divergence that is going on in the internal structure of the market. Basically the tech hardware is doing well, AI names are doing well, but then the traditional industries are doing less well.
subtitles.zh: 这说明市场内部结构存在巨大分化。科技硬件表现好，AI相关公司表现好，但传统行业表现较差。
zh_highlights: 市场内部结构存在巨大分化

subtitles.en: So that is telling you that there's a huge divergence that is going on in the internal structure of the market. Basically the tech hardware is doing well, AI names are doing well, but then the traditional industries are doing less well.
subtitles.zh: 所以市场内部结构分化巨大，科技硬件和AI股表现强劲，而传统行业则相对疲软。
zh_highlights: 科技硬件和AI股表现强劲
en_highlights: traditional industries are doing less well

clips.speaker_context: Managing Partner and CIO at Lotus Asset Management

clips.speaker: How Home
clips.title: 龙泰资管郝洪：成长股与价值股分化达极端，预计未来两个月将出现板块轮动
title_lines: 成长股与价值股分化达极端
预计未来两个月将出现板块轮动

subtitles.en: Yeah, well I think the Chinese names are getting comparable valuation from the US and some of them are actually trading at a much higher multiples.
subtitles.zh: 是的，我认为中国公司估值与美国同行相当，有些甚至估值倍数更高。

subtitles.en: And yet today performance is actually beating the US peers. All right, so I think at this stage we're actually seeing the relative performance of the growth stocks, the tech hardware stocks, and the semi-names, substantially outperform the traditional value names.
subtitles.zh: 而且当前表现实际上超过了美国同行。所以现阶段，成长股、科技硬件股和半导体股的表现大幅优于传统价值股。
zh_highlights: 成长股、科技硬件股和半导体股

subtitles.en: The outperformance has reached a very sort of an extreme that we haven't seen in the past history. Only once, that was in early 2021.
subtitles.zh: 这种超额表现已达到历史罕见的极端水平，仅在2021年初出现过一次。
en_highlights: haven't seen in the past history

subtitles.en: And after such strong relative performance, there tend to be a sector rotation going on. All right, so we're expecting a sector rotation towards the traditional value sector, probably in the next two months or so.
subtitles.zh: 在如此强劲的相对表现之后，往往会出现板块轮动。因此，我们预计未来两个月左右，资金将轮动至传统价值板块。

clips.speaker_context: Managing Partner and CIO at Lotus Asset Management

clips.speaker: How Home
clips.title: 龙泰资管郝洪：央行新增资金流向高科技，房地产投资持续下降，经济结构转型加速
title_lines: 央行新增资金流向高科技
房地产投资持续下降，经济结构转型加速
title_highlights: 央行新增资金流向高科技

subtitles.en: Yeah, well, I think back then, you know, the story really is that, you know, when the PBOC eased monetary policy, the Chinese market would rally.
subtitles.zh: 是的，过去的情况是，当央行放松货币政策时，中国市场就会上涨。

subtitles.en: Well, I think, you know, ever since 2023, after COVID and the economy reopened for business, you know, we're actually seeing the newly created money on the PBOC balance sheet. It's actually going into the newer sectors, you know, for example, the semi-names we discussed just now.
subtitles.zh: 但自2023年疫情后经济重启以来，我们看到央行资产负债表上的新增资金实际上流向了新兴行业，比如我们刚才讨论的半导体领域。
zh_highlights: 新增资金流向新兴行业

subtitles.en: And less than less money is going to the traditional real estate sector. As a result, you know, the FAI in real estate investments are actually going down very high double digit year and year in the latest figure.
subtitles.zh: 而流入传统房地产行业的资金越来越少。结果，房地产固定资产投资同比大幅下降，最新数据为两位数降幅。
zh_highlights: 房地产固定资产投资同比大幅下降
en_highlights: going down very high double digit

subtitles.en: That is showing you that, you know, the economy is continuing to cut back on real estate investments, which is a good news, you know, basically the new money is going to, you know, more promising sector state is giving investors and the economy better return.
subtitles.zh: 这表明经济持续减少房地产投资，这是好消息，因为新增资金流向了更有前景的行业，为投资者和经济带来更好回报。
zh_highlights: 新增资金流向更有前景的行业
en_highlights: cut back on real estate investments

subtitles.en: And I think this trend would continue. So I think ever since early 2023, you know, we've seen, you know, the new monies on the PBOC balance sheet are going into high tech growth sector.
subtitles.zh: 我认为这一趋势将持续。自2023年初以来，央行资产负债表上的新增资金一直流向高科技成长行业。
zh_highlights: 新增资金流向高科技成长行业

subtitles.en: And also, if you look at the policy statement, you know, many of these new sectors are actually going to be the new growth engine for the Chinese economy.
subtitles.zh: 此外，从政策声明来看，这些新兴行业将成为中国经济的新增长引擎。

clips.speaker_context: Managing Partner and CIO at Lotus Asset Management

clips.speaker: How Home
clips.title: 龙泰资管郝洪：消费结构转变，服务支出强劲增长，年轻一代更重体验消费
title_lines: 服务支出强劲增长，年轻一代更重体验消费

subtitles.en: I think the consumer consumption which is measured in retail sales growth hasn't been performing as well as expected, you know, because in the first half of this year, the subsidies, you know, for people to buy electronic goods and also buy cars has been sort of removed.
subtitles.zh: 我认为以零售额增长衡量的消费表现不及预期，因为今年上半年，购买电子产品和汽车的补贴被取消了。

subtitles.en: So I think the EV sales alone, for example, this year, dragged down the sales retail sales growth by one and a half percentage point. And therefore, you know, the resulting figure is a flat year-on-year retail sales growth.
subtitles.zh: 仅电动汽车销售一项就拖累零售额增长1.5个百分点，导致零售额同比持平。
zh_highlights: 电动汽车销售拖累零售额增长1.5个百分点
en_highlights: one and a half percentage point

subtitles.en: But if you look at the service industry, though, you know, if you look at the service spending, right? So service spending year-on-year is up almost 6% and beating expectation.
subtitles.zh: 但如果你看服务业，服务支出同比增长近6%，超出预期。

subtitles.en: I tell you, it's telling us that, you know, people are actually spending more on service-related consumption rather than on goods consumption. So as a result, you know, you know, we will continue to see our spending on service continue to outpace service spending on goods.
subtitles.zh: 这表明人们实际上在服务相关消费上支出更多，而非商品消费。因此，服务支出将持续超过商品支出。
zh_highlights: 服务支出超过商品支出

subtitles.en: And I think, you know, this after COVID, this days, the Chinese people has changed their spending habits. You know, many of them, especially the younger Chinese generation, is spending a lot more on experience-related consumption.
subtitles.zh: 我认为疫情后，中国人的消费习惯发生了变化。许多人，尤其是年轻一代，在体验式消费上支出更多。

subtitles.en: You know, for example, they're buying concert tickets, they're going out camping and also, you know, overseas ships are also on the rise as well. And so many of these spending are not recorded in the retail sales figure.
subtitles.zh: 例如，他们购买演唱会门票、去露营，海外旅行也在增加。这些支出很多并未计入零售额数据。
en_highlights: not recorded in the retail sales figure

clips.speaker_context: Managing Partner and CIO at Lotus Asset Management
